svg.title: Student Attendance System - Use Case Diagram

g.text: Student Attendance System - Use Case Diagram
Protected API use cases require a valid JWT and the appropriate role.
Login is a precondition, rather than a repeated included use case.
The phone submits a short-lived setup token, without a JWT.
Creating the request and polling its status require lecturer authentication.
Direct browser location capture is also available.
POST /api/auth/register is public in the current routes.
The React interface has no registration page.
